flags: Story writes (and so take lineage) follow the AG-DOCS switch (YAMAKAN_AG_DOCS_OFF=1); take commands read stories and apply timeline operations
deviations: The interface is four commands (yamakan.take.list, .compare, .proposeReplace, .apply); no editor UI in this task
A replacement changes the timeline clip (new operation clip.replaceMedia), not the story's selectedTakeId, which stays the storyboard's choice for assembly
Take lineage is an optional field of a story take (label, outputHash, up to 8 pinned inputs); stories without it keep their bytes
Comparison previews are the indexed 90-pixel footage thumbnail (from the edit proxy when ready) or the still itself; the command decodes no original
clip.replaceMedia is also part of yamakan.project.applyBatch with the timeline's own checks only (like clip.add); probe, consent, lineage and story binding are guaranteed through yamakan.take.apply

tests.result: 8 take tests: replace one of three shots with every other part of the export deep-equal and list/compare/propose changing nothing; undo, redo, reopen and undo return the exact old take; still to footage with sound, title card to a take, footage back to a still; stale, forged-mapping and story-changed proposals refused (REVISION_CONFLICT); a take shorter than its clip, a missing object on disk, a missing probe and a wrong lineage hash refused; a revoked reference consent refuses and leaves the clip; scopes (read principal cannot apply), unknown take/shot, duplicate compare ids; locked track, retimed clip and unlinked sound (old or new media) refused; effects, animation and sound gain/fades preserved
